audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart read Akshan / Skill / Skill / Skill / Skill / Skill / Akshan while every why-line under it says the row favours Volibear, and the packet chart is Skill then Volibear for rows 1-6.
audit.why: 52.39% over 754 games and the packet levelChart both say Volibear holds rows 1-6. The page was rendering a side that contradicted its own explanation.
audit.corrected: Row 0 Skill; rows 1-6 Volibear. Proposed as seven matched full/content pairs so the chart lands as one atomic group, with ratings raised to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1] and late credited Stormbringer with attack speed and sustain, and no Akshan cooldown was ever given.
audit.why: Stormbringer leaps, slows, damages, grants bonus Health and disables nearby towers — no attack speed, no healing. Attack speed is The Relentless Storm.
audit.corrected: Heroic Swing 18/16.5/15/13.5/12s and Comeuppance 100/85/70s written into spikes and mid; Stormbringer described as bonus health plus the tower disable.

audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer told you to 'walk him into a wall for the stun' and to 'Q-stun him against a wall' — Volibear has no wall-dependent stun.
audit.why: Thundering Smash (300 range, 12s at rank 1) grants speed toward enemies and stuns the FIRST ONE HE ATTACKS. Terrain is irrelevant to it. The wall that matters belongs to Akshan: Heroic Swing needs terrain to grapple into, so the open-ground read is inverted.
audit.corrected: Rewrote spikes[0], mid, whys[1], wants.you[0] and wants.foe[1] around the attack-based stun and Akshan's terrain requirement.

edits.before: Level 2 favours you once Q lets you wall-stun a CC-less marksman.
edits.after: Level 2 favours you: Thundering Smash stuns without needing a wall.

edits.before: Akshan is a squishy ranged pick with no hard CC until R — once you have Q, walk him into a wall for the stun and W-proc him before he can E-swing away.
edits.after: Thundering Smash stuns the first enemy you attack — no wall needed. Charge it as Heroic Swing (18s at rank 1) goes down, then mark and re-bite with Frenzied Maul.

edits.before: His R is a long-range execute, not a duel tool; your R's health and attack speed let you burst him down whenever his E dash is on cooldown.
edits.after: Comeuppance (100s) stores bullets at 2500 range — a sniping tool, not a duel button. Stormbringer's bonus health wins the brawl outright.

edits.before: From 2 on it's your lane. Akshan is a squishy marksman with only an E dash for safety; land a wall-Q stun, W-proc, and E and he melts. Watch his E cooldown and all-in the moment it's down.
edits.after: From 2 on it's your lane. Heroic Swing needs terrain to grapple and is down 18s at rank 1 — that window is your all-in. Thundering Smash stuns on the attack, so close first, then Frenzied Maul twice.

edits.before: You win every sidelane duel. His R is a sniping tool, not a bruiser button, and your R sustain shrugs off his poke. If he opts to roam, punish him by taking his tower — you out-scale as a 1v1 threat.
edits.after: You win every sidelane duel. Comeuppance is a sniping tool, not a bruiser button, and Stormbringer's bonus health plus its tower disable turns your dive in. If he roams, punish it by taking his tower.

edits.before: Q-stun him against a wall to start every trade
edits.after: Open every trade with a Thundering Smash stun

edits.before: Poke with Q passive and kite with E swing
edits.after: Poke with Avengerang, kite with the swing

edits.before: Avoid your Q by staying near open ground
edits.after: Keep terrain nearby for a Heroic Swing exit
